column5: declare @p1 int set @p1=1 exec sp_prepare @p1 output,NULL,N'select * from (select GVA12.ID_GVA12, GVA07.MISMO_CLIE as SELECCIONADO, GVA07.ID_GVA07, GVA07.MISMO_CLIE,                                  CASE WHEN GVA07.T_COMP_CAN = ''REC'' THEN GVA07.T_COMP                                                                                           ELSE GVA07.T_COMP_CAN                                  END AS T_COMP_BROWSE,                                  CASE WHEN GVA07.T_COMP_CAN = ''REC'' THEN GVA07.N_COMP                                                                                           ELSE GVA07.N_COMP_CAN                                  END AS N_COMP_BROWSE,                                  GVA07.T_COMP,GVA07.N_COMP, GVA07.T_COMP_CAN,GVA07.N_COMP_CAN,                                  CASE WHEN GVA07.T_COMP_CAN = ''REC'' THEN GVA46.ID_GVA46                                                                                           ELSE -1*GVA12.ID_GVA12                                  END AS ID_COMPROBANTE,                                  CASE WHEN GVA07.T_COMP_CAN = ''REC'' THEN NULL                                                                                      ELSE GVA46.ID_GVA46                                  END AS ID_PARENT,                   CASE WHEN GVA07.T_COMP_CAN = ''REC'' THEN GVA12FAC.FECHA_EMIS                        ELSE GVA12.FECHA_EMIS                   END FECHA_EMIS_BROWSE,                  GVA12.FECHA_EMIS,                  GVA12.CANT_HOJAS as ID_PARENT_EDIT,                   CASE WHEN GVA07.T_COMP_CAN = ''REC'' THEN ''F''                       ELSE GVA15.CLASE_OPERACION                        END AS CLASE_OPERACION,                   CASE WHEN GVA07.T_COMP_CAN = ''REC'' THEN                                             CASE dbo.fn_GetFechaVencimiento(GVA12.FECHA_EMIS, GVA46.FECHA_VTO, GVA46.ALTERNATIVA_1, GVA46.ALTERNATIVA_2)                                                  WHEN  1 THEN GVA46.FECHA_VTO                                                  WHEN 11 THEN GVA46.FECHA_VTO                                                  WHEN  2 THEN GVA46.ALTERNATIVA_1                                                  WHEN 12 THEN GVA46.ALTERNATIVA_1                                                  WHEN  3 THEN GVA46.ALTERNATIVA_2                                                  WHEN 13 THEN GVA46.ALTERNATIVA_2                                             END                        ELSE GVA12.FECHA_EMIS                        END AS FECHA_VTO_BROWSE,                   CASE WHEN GVA07.T_COMP_CAN = ''REC'' THEN GVA07.IMPORTE_VT                        ELSE GVA12.IMPORTE                        END AS IMPORTE_VT,                   CASE WHEN GVA07.T_COMP_CAN = ''REC'' THEN GVA07.IMP_VT_UNI                        ELSE GVA12.UNIDADES                        END AS IMP_VT_UNI,                   GVA12.CANT_HOJAS as ID_COMPROBANTE_EDIT,                   GVA07.ID_GVA12_CAN,                   GVA07.FECHA_VTO,GVA07.IMP_CAN_UN,                   GVA07.IMPORTE_VT AS PENDIENTE , GVA07.IMPORTE_VT AS PENDIENTE_U , GVA14.COD_CLIENT, GVA15.DIF_CAMBIO, GVA14.RAZON_SOCI,                    CASE WHEN GVA07.T_COMP_CAN = ''REC'' AND GVA07.ID_GVA12_CAN IS NOT NULL THEN SUMACOMPROBANTE.IMPORTE_CAN                        ELSE GVA07.IMPORT_CAN                   END IMPORT_CAN_BROWSE,                  CASE WHEN GVA07.T_COMP_CAN = ''REC'' AND GVA07.ID_GVA12_CAN IS NOT NULL THEN SUMACOMPROBANTE.IMPORTE_CAN_UN                        ELSE GVA07.IMP_CAN_UN                   END IMP_CAN_UN_BROWSE,                   CASE WHEN GVA07.T_COMP_CAN = ''REC'' THEN GVA14FAC.COD_CLIENT                        ELSE GVA14.COD_CLIENT                   END COD_CLIENT_BROWSE,                   CASE WHEN GVA07.T_COMP_CAN = ''REC'' THEN GVA14FAC.RAZON_SOCI                        ELSE GVA14.RAZON_SOCI                   END RAZON_SOCI_BROWSE,                   GVA07.IMPORT_CAN AS IMPORT_CAN,                   GVA07.FECHA_VTO AS FECHA_VTO_CALCULADO,                   GVA14.RAZON_SOCI AS MENSAJE_FECHA_CALCULADA,                   GVA14.RAZON_SOCI AS ALTERNATIVAS,                   GVA14.ID_GVA14 AS ID_GVA14,                        GVA07.FECHA_VTO AS ALTERNATIVA_1,                   GVA12FAC.ID_GVA12 AS ID_GVA12FAC,                   GVA12.ID_HISTORIAL_RENDICION AS ID_GVA12Editable                   from GVA07                   LEFT JOIN GVA46 ON GVA07.T_COMP = GVA46.T_COMP AND GVA07.N_COMP = GVA46.N_COMP and GVA07.FECHA_VTO = GVA46.FECHA_VTO                      LEFT JOIN GVA15 ON GVA15.IDENT_COMP = GVA07.T_COMP_CAN                   LEFT JOIN GVA12 ON GVA07.T_COMP_CAN = GVA12.T_COMP AND GVA07.N_COMP_CAN = GVA12.N_COMP                   LEFT JOIN GVA12 AS GVA12FAC ON GVA07.T_COMP = GVA12FAC.T_COMP AND GVA07.N_COMP = GVA12FAC.N_COMP                   LEFT JOIN GVA14 ON GVA12.COD_CLIENT = GVA14.COD_CLIENT                   LEFT JOIN GVA14 AS GVA14FAC ON GVA12FAC.COD_CLIENT = GVA14FAC.COD_CLIENT                   LEFT JOIN (SELECT T_COMP,N_COMP,FECHA_VTO, ID_GVA12_CAN,                                          SUM(case when GVA07.T_COMP_CAN = ''REC'' then GVA07.IMPORT_CAN                                                                       else case when TIPOCOMP.CLASE_OPERACION = ''NC'' then GVA07.IMPORT_CAN                                               WHEN TIPOCOMP.CLASE_OPERACION = ''ND'' then GVA07.IMPORT_CAN * -1                                               end                                          end ) AS IMPORTE_CAN,                                          SUM(case when GVA07.T_COMP_CAN = ''REC'' then GVA07.IMP_CAN_UN                                                                       else case when TIPOCOMP.CLASE_OPERACION = ''NC'' then GVA07.IMP_CAN_UN                                               WHEN TIPOCOMP.CLASE_OPERACION = ''ND'' then GVA07.IMP_CAN_UN * -1                                               end                                          end ) AS IMPORTE_CAN_UN                              from GVA07                              LEFT JOIN GVA15 TIPOCOMP ON TIPOCOMP.IDENT_COMP = GVA07.T_COMP_CAN                              WHERE ID_GVA12_CAN IS NOT NULL                              GROUP BY T_COMP,N_COMP,FECHA_VTO,ID_GVA12_CAN) AS SUMACOMPROBANTE ON SUMACOMPROBANTE.T_COMP = GVA07.T_COMP AND                              SUMACOMPROBANTE.N_COMP = GVA07.N_COMP AND SUMACOMPROBANTE.FECHA_VTO = GVA07.FECHA_VTO AND GVA07.ID_GVA12_CAN = SUMACOMPROBANTE.ID_GVA12_CAN ) AS GVA07                   WHERE ID_GVA12_CAN in  (372483, 372479, 372478, 372477, 372473, 372472, 372471, 372470, 372469, 372468, 372467, 372363, 372360, 372355, 372351, 372343, 372342, 372341, 372333, 372331, 372304, 372244)                    ORDER BY GVA07.ID_GVA07 ',1 select @p1

declare @p1 int set @p1=8 exec sp_prepare @p1 output,NULL,N'  select ID_ASIENTO_COMPROBANTE_SB, ASIENTO_COMPROBANTE_SB.N_INTERNO, CONTABILIZADO, ASIENTO_COMPROBANTE_SB.ASIENTO_ANULACION,         USUARIO_CONTABILIZACION, FECHA_CONTABILIZACION, TERMINAL_CONTABILIZACION,         TRANSFERIDO_CN, NRO_LOTE_CN_GENERADO, CLASE_ASIENTO_COMP,         USUARIO_GENERACION, FECHA_GENERACION, TERMINAL_GENERACION, ESTADO_LOTE_CN  FROM ASIENTO_COMPROBANTE_SB with (nolock)  JOIN SBA04 with (nolock) ON ASIENTO_COMPROBANTE_SB.N_INTERNO = SBA04.N_INTERNO  LEFT JOIN    (select LMAX.*, CLASE_ASIENTO_COMP,            USUARIO_GENERACION, FECHA_GENERACION, TERMINAL_GENERACION, ESTADO_LOTE_CN from (    (select ID_COMPROBANTE, ASIENTO_ANULACION, max(L.NRO_LOTE_CN_GENERADO) as NRO_LOTE_CN_GENERADO    from LOTE_CN_GENERADO_COMPROBANTE C with (nolock)    join LOTE_CN_GENERADO L with (nolock) on C.ID_LOTE_CN_GENERADO = L.ID_LOTE_CN_GENERADO    where COD_MODULO = ''SB'' and L.ESTADO_LOTE_CN = ''Generado''   group by ID_COMPROBANTE, ASIENTO_ANULACION    ) LMAX    left join LOTE_CN_GENERADO_COMPROBANTE LCGC with (nolock) on (LCGC.ID_COMPROBANTE = LMAX.ID_COMPROBANTE AND LCGC.ASIENTO_ANULACION = LMAX.ASIENTO_ANULACION)    JOIN LOTE_CN_GENERADO LCG with (nolock) ON (LCGC.ID_LOTE_CN_GENERADO = LCG.ID_LOTE_CN_GENERADO and LCG.NRO_LOTE_CN_GENERADO = LMAX.NRO_LOTE_CN_GENERADO)    )) as LOTE    ON ASIENTO_COMPROBANTE_SB.N_INTERNO = LOTE.ID_COMPROBANTE AND       ASIENTO_COMPROBANTE_SB.ASIENTO_ANULACION = LOTE.ASIENTO_ANULACION  WHERE SBA04.ID_SBA04 in  (175135, 175137, 175140, 175141, 175142, 175143, 175144, 175145, 175146, 175147, 175148, 175158, 175161, 175163, 175165, 175167, 175172, 175173, 175187, 175188, 175189, 175193)  ',1 select @p1

declare @p1 int set @p1=2 exec sp_prepare @p1 output,NULL,N' SELECT ID_DIRECCION_ENTREGA, COD_DIRECCION_ENTREGA, DIRECCION, COD_CLIENTE, 	                  COD_PROVINCIA, LOCALIDAD, HABITUAL, CODIGO_POSTAL, TELEFONO1, TELEFONO2, TOMA_IMPUESTO_HABITUAL,                    FILLER, OBSERVACIONES, AL_FIJ_IB3, ALI_ADI_IB, ALI_FIJ_IB, IB_L, IB_L3, II_IB3, LIB, PORC_L             FROM DIRECCION_ENTREGA  WHERE EXISTS (Select TRICK.COD_GVA14 FROM (SELECT TOP 100 PERCENT COD_GVA14 FROM (           SELECT GVA14.*,          case when IsNull(FECHA_INHA,0) <= 0 then ''No'' else ''Sí'' end AS INHABILITADO,          ISNULL(DESC_RUBRO, '''') AS DESC_RUBRO,          NOMBRE_PRO,          GVA133.COD_PAIS AS COD_PAIS,          NOM_PAIS,          ISNULL(GVA62.NOMBRE_GRU, '''') AS NOMBRE_GRU,          ISNULL(GVA62.DOMICILIO, '''') AS DOMICILIO_GE,          ISNULL(GVA62.LOCALIDAD, '''') AS LOCALIDAD_GE,          ISNULL(GVA62.C_POSTAL, '''') AS  C_POSTAL_GE,          ISNULL(gva62.TELEFONO_1, '''')  AS TELEFONO_1_GE,          ISNULL(gva62.TELEFONO_2, '''')  AS TELEFONO_2_GE,          ISNULL(GVA62.OBSERVACIO, '''')  AS OBSERVACIO_GE,          ISNULL((SELECT NOMBRE_PRO FROM GVA18 WHERE GVA62.COD_GVA18 = GVA18.COD_GVA18), '''') AS NOMBRE_PRO_GE,          ISNULL(GVA62.E_MAIL, '''') AS E_MAIL_GE   FROM GVA14   LEFT JOIN GVA151 ON GVA14.COD_RUBRO = GVA151.COD_RUBRO   LEFT JOIN GVA18 ON GVA14.COD_PROVIN = GVA18.COD_PROVIN   LEFT JOIN GVA133 ON GVA18.COD_PAIS = GVA133.COD_PAIS   LEFT JOIN GVA62 ON GVA14.GRUPO_EMPR = GVA62.GRUPO_EMPR ) AS GVA14   WHERE (( COD_GVA14 = ''fc.280'')) )TRICK WHERE TRICK.COD_GVA14=DIRECCION_ENTREGA.COD_CLIENTE) ',1 select @p1

IF ((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AXDBINFO) = 0) OR  NOT EXISTS (    SELECT 1    FROM   (SELECT TOP 1 SYSTEMTYPE, COUNTRYCODE, HLNUMBER, VERSION, DATO_SISTEMA    FROM AXDBINFO   ORDER BY LAST_UPDATE DESC) LAST_AXDBINFO   WHERE   LAST_AXDBINFO.COUNTRYCODE = 'AR'   AND LAST_AXDBINFO.DATO_SISTEMA = (SELECT VERSION_SISTEMA FROM DATO_SISTEMA)   AND LAST_AXDBINFO.HLNUMBER = '001174/003'   AND LAST_AXDBINFO.SYSTEMTYPE = 'GESTION'   AND LAST_AXDBINFO.VERSION = (SELECT MAX(CAST(VERSION as INTEGER)) FROM VERSION) )

CREATE FUNCTION FN_AXDBINFO()  RETURNS @SYS_DBINFO TABLE  ( SYSTEMTYPE  varchar(50),    COUNTRYCODE varchar(10),    HLNUMBER    varchar(15),    VERSION     varchar(20),    DATO_SISTEMA varchar(20)   ) AS  BEGIN    INSERT @SYS_DBINFO (SYSTEMTYPE, COUNTRYCODE, HLNUMBER, VERSION, DATO_SISTEMA)    SELECT TOP 1 SYSTEMTYPE, COUNTRYCODE, HLNUMBER, VERSION, DATO_SISTEMA    FROM AXDBINFO    ORDER BY LAST_UPDATE DESC    RETURN  END
